issues: React Native Web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — recommend migrating to 'boxShadow'.
Invalid style property: padding value '0 8px' is not supported on RN Web — replace with paddingVertical/paddingHorizontal (single values).
'Only Present' and 'Only Exceptions' Switches have no testID; consider adding testID='dv-only-present' / 'dv-only-exceptions' + 'dv-apply' for future automation.

OPTIONAL: Fix padding shorthand '0 8px' → paddingVertical:0/paddingHorizontal:8 (RN Web does not accept multi-value shorthand).
